Spa offerings range from morning yoga sessions before hitting the ski slopes to relaxing reflexology after a long days hiking
The redwood-panelled Grill Restaurant specialises in local sustainable ranch meats fresh fish and seasonal farm-to-table produce.
Amanganis enchanted remote setting and flexible spaces provide an ideal location for occasions of all kinds.

Description: HotelDescription#The Bray House is a classic, two-level home located on a private cul-de-sac in Teton Village, offering guests a great mountain location in either the winter or the summer. Winter guests will appreciate the heated boot room with benches and boot dryers before taking advantage of the ski-on/ski-off access available when conditions allow operation of the Moose Creek Chairlift. The front door of the house leads into a spacious entry area with plenty of closet space. There is a large, well-equipped kitchen featuring a sunny breakfast nook that seats six and a convenient pass-through window into the dining area. The dining room table easily accommodates ten people. The living room is spacious, and offers stunning views of the Sleeping Indian Mountain from the oversized picture windows. The north wall is entirely made up of rock, and contains a large wood-burning fireplace. A flat screen television, DVD, and stereo make this a very comfortable room to relax in after a day on the slopes. Adjacent to both the living room and kitchen is an oversized outdoor deck. A picnic table, built-in seating, deck furniture and a six person Jacuzzi make this a great outdoor space. On the main level there is a king bedroom with a full bath. The stairway leads down into a den area. Once the privacy screen is drawn, it doubles as a 5th bedroom with a queen sleeper sofa and a flat screen TV. The king master bedroom and en-suite bath are located on the lower level. There are two additional bedrooms, one with twin beds, the other with extra long twin beds. Each have private bathrooms with walk in showers. All of the bathrooms have been renovated with natural stone tiles. Description: HotelDescription#Located just five miles from Jackson Hole Mountain Resort and 10 minutes away from downtown Jackson, Teton Pines is at once convenient and secluded. Graciously landscaped, the resort complex winds around a scenic pond and stream, enjoyed by all including the resident wildlife. In the winter, a free shuttle bus ferries guests to and from Jackson Hole Mountain Resort. Townhome rentals come with complimentary use of Teton Sports Club, including its fitness equipment and outdoor hot tub. Guests may walk to the Teton Pines Golf Course and tennis courts, as well as a gourmet market, well-stocked liquor store, two beloved restaurants, a bustling coffeehouse, a UPS store and a salon, among other conveniences. A carved bear cub standing beside the front door bids hello, a warm welcome echoed throughout this elegant townhome. The experience begins with the graciously landscaped walkway leading to the front porch. The foyer greets guests with tile flooring, key hooks, coat closet, an upholstered bench and decorative bouquets. A hallway leads to the laundry room and attached two-car garage. The first bedroom on the ground floor features a four-poster queen bed with a carved wood headboard. A matching armoire hides a TV. A velvet armchair accents the room, and storage options abound between the two closets and matching nightstands. Glass doors lead to a private patio with chairs. The ensuite bathroom features decorative tile and a shower/tub. The second bedroom offers two twin beds with plaid bedding atop dark wood frames and a matching bedroom set  accent chairs and armoire. Glass doors grant patio access. The ensuite bathroom echoes its neighbor with decorative tilework and a shower/tub. Carpeted stairs lead to the second floor; a stag painting hangs along the stairwell and at the top landing, a decorative vignette incorporates an antique saddle, mirror and chest. The upstairs master suite begins with an office defined by a wraparound desk outfitted with a printer and phone.

Located just four miles from Jackson Hole Mountain Resort and Grand Teton National Park, Mountain Maple #3 is the perfect location no matter what youd like to see and do in Jackson Hole. This two bedroom, two bathroom located on the top floor unit has a great view of the mountain. A slate entry greets guests, and a coat rack encourages them to stay awhile. The first bedroom, just beyond the entrance, features a pair of twin beds topped by plaid duvets and bear accent pillows, and backed by grey wood bedframes. Crossed arrows decorate the bedside lamps, framed posters animate the wall, and a closet boasts built-in shelves. In the hallway, a spacious bathroom offers a double vanity, a washer and dryer, and a white tile shower/tub. The great room encompasses the kitchen, living and dining areas, all under a cathedral ceiling. The open kitchen offers white countertops, a basin sink, modern appliances, pendant lights, and a breakfast bar with three stools. In the living area, a patterned couch complements a leather chair, all of which face the wood burning stove. Photography decorates the walls, and a TV encourages lounging. An antique pine dining table seats six. Sliding glass doors lead to the deck, which beckons with mountain views, a gas grill and chairs. Climb carpeted stairs and find a loft with a master suite marked by a four-poster bed draped with an Aztec duvet and accented by matching wooden nightstands. Additional amenities include a TV, chest of drawers and large closet. The neighboring bathroom echoes the downstairs boudoir with its white tile, double vanity and shower/tub.
